title: Cozy&Comfy
description: A Minecraft Modpack for peaceful and cozy vibes enjoyers
body:
This is a modpack for Cozy and Comfortable vibes enjoyers
ether you like exploring, building, farming, or cooking Cozy&Comfy has you covered!

It is suggested to play the modpack on peaceful diffculty

**some of the features that you might enjoy!**

-You can go exploring and find all of the different biomes and environments!
![Exploring](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ec42de288f301f5354c8c3919c44857d7ec7efeb.png)

-You can start cooking and make your favorite food
![cooking](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/87f8e652e7128153f03fb6dabe4b6c3dd6d74d59.png)
-And enjoy serving it!
![serving](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/93a7b3197f79ef87d7766408c8be966a039ed506.png)

-You can go farming and farm all the crops you want
![Farming](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/feead56e56459ef3be81d6e66c028d6ea762b6ee.png)

-You can go hunting in the wild, and explore all different kind of animals
![Hunting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/01e918f3a1132debc214a0e5d46400a2a05fd654.png)

So, what are you waiting for?
try the modpack for your self!

This is a modpack was made by me(codycat) and my team(lucidict, kamiikos)

Requirements: It is required to have at least 8gb of ram and allow Minecraft to use 4gb

Note!: if you find any error or problems please join the discord server and report them in the modpack-bugs channel, thank you.

future plans: planing to add a questbook to guide the player through the modpack
